title: Degen Radar Input
description: Analyze Solana tokens by combining momentum, liquidity, holder breadth, tracked-wallet flow and market attention into explainable pattern and risk analysis.

tokenAddresses.title: Token Addresses
tokenAddresses.description: One or more Solana token mint addresses to analyze. Up to 50 tokens can be processed in one run.

maxTokens.title: Maximum Tokens
maxTokens.description: Maximum number of token addresses to process from the list.

observationWindowHours.title: Observation Window (hours)
observationWindowHours.description: Observation window used by time-dependent signal sources.

minSignalAvailability.title: Minimum Signal Availability
minSignalAvailability.description: Minimum fraction of configured signals that must be available before a token is analyzed. Default: 60%.

enabledSignalCategories.title: Signal Categories
enabledSignalCategories.description: Select which signal categories Degen Radar should collect and analyze.

trackedWalletAddresses.title: Tracked Wallet Addresses
trackedWalletAddresses.description: Optional Solana wallet addresses to monitor for token flow. Wallet-flow data is unavailable when no tracked wallets are provided.
